items.title: George "Kid Sheik" Colar Interview, 1958-07-20
items.q: I played with Buddy on his last, when he was down, on his last go around. And I played with him several jobs, you know, and he played second trumpet.

ctx.x: What was his typical style of playing or his favorite type of music?

Oh, he was, well, Buddy, he was a fellow who would play. He didn't worry about, you know, high notes and all, but he played so sweet. Everything he played was in the staff and it was sweet. I mean, everything was sweet. I played with Buddy on his last, when he was down, on his last go around. And I played with him several jobs, you know, and he played second trumpet. He's a sweet second trumpet player. And I played a couple of jobs with him, you know. And he was living right there on St. Philip and St. Lord,…
It was shortly before his death. It was shortly before Buddy Petit's death that you were playing those jobs with him.
